## MARKET SUMMARY

## INDIA

The Indian ship recycling market remains firm during the week, with buyers showing strong interest in acquiring suitable vessels for recycling. Local steel markets have softened, although the decline in the USD/INR exchange rate has provided some support to buying sentiment. A sanctioned LPG carrier was reportedly sold for recycling into India during the week, with no other sales reported.
